delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff USD [Settlement Amount] (the “Settlement Amount”), in accordance with the timing and method to be set out in this Agreement. 2. RELEASE. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
